reviewNotes: Twenty-five calendar abbreviations, Stardrop messages, consumable prompts, diagnostics, and status notices were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover exact placeholders and caret formatting, concatenation boundaries and spaces, developer labels, established item names, gender-neutral player text, abbreviations, punctuation, and UI clarity; both found no remaining objective issue.
